verdict.rationale: Supabase's security docs say it offers EU-region hosting for data residency, backed by a Data Processing Agreement. Its self-hosting guide supports deploying the whole stack on your own infrastructure via Docker Compose for full control over data and compliance needs. Together these let a user decide where data lives. Missing for 10: documentation of selecting a region at managed-project creation and the list of available regions, any statement on whether backups, Storage files and Edge Functions stay in the chosen region, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
